text: Standing in this brightly-lit, modern space, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The environment is clinical yet inviting, marked by glass walls and vibrant graphics that suggest innovation. As I approach the 'R+D' wall, I am reminded of humanity's drive to understand and reshape the world through research and development. I am eager to engage with these ideas, and I sense the weight of collective effort echoing through these exhibits. Being here, I feel both inspired and a little small in the shadow of so much ingenuity.
